decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith(Design and Access statement. 010P2, 020P2, 021P2, 030P2, 031P2, 050P2,051P2,052P2, 053P2,070P2,LL412-200-001 received 5/7/12
Email re flood risk received 1/8/12) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted structure have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - The permission hereby granted shall be for a limited period expiring three years from the date of this permission when the use shall cease, the structure removed and the land restored to its previous condition.

Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted for a marketing suite shall not be carried on outside the following times unless otherwise as agreed in writing by the LPA: Monday to Fridays 10am-6pm and Saturdays 10am-4pm.
description: Construction of a marketing suite, access road and surface car park for a temporary period of three years
